message.en_US: Allez! This way!
This is a challenge version of Carnollo, with harsher combos created by Gwas
It is \c[1]not recommended \c[0] to take this on before base Carnollo
You will receive more fragments for phasing the boss here
Creator note: funeral might be impossible to hitless, don't feel too down if u cant pass it
Welcome to the lobby of the SBBF Carnellio mod!
Please note that these fights are intended to be \c[1]very difficult\c[0]
Party members are allowed, but the fights are best experienced in solo.
As a balancing factor, any added party members will reduce your damage boost.
If you are interested, check out the original boss on \c[3]Skill Based Boss Fights\c[0] (Roblox)
(yes the game is on roblox and has its flaws, but its f2p)
Have fun and remember there's always the difficulty assistance in the settings!
Expect bugs! This is my first real mod! Contact me on Discord @fatetraitor for any complaints or questions or reports!
RECORD AND DM YOUR SOLO IF YOU DO MANAGE TO WIN!!
ME & MY FRIENDS WOULD LOVE TO SEE!! ESPECIALLY IF YOU HAVENT PLAYED SBBF BEFORE
I will teach you about \c[3]Sigil Draw\c[0]
\c[3]Sigil Draw\c[0] forces Carnollo to reveal his entire combo intention before he attacks
By \c[2]reading\c[0] the sigils, you can  determine how to best dodge the upcoming combo
\c[2]Learning\c[0] the attack behind each sigil will increase your \c[1]survival rate\c[0]
As you phase the boss, combos will get longer and longer
Although it is unintended, you are free to use \c[3]quick-menu\c[0] to freeze the game and read the combo
Be wary of Carnollo's last stand \c[1] funeral combo\c[0], which contains a massive number of sigils.
I will tell you about the unique conditions imposed by Carnollo
As in the source game, Carnollo will always have 12,550,000 HP (unless you have the NG+ levelmatch)
Carnollo is balanced at level 45, but his attack will scale to a little below your level if you are higher than that.
To balance his insane hp, your \c[1]damage is buffed\c[0] by approximately \c[1]10x\c[0] at the start of the fight
This boost is reduced and divided amongst all your party members
All of Carnollo's attacks apply various \c[1]debuffs\c[0] to you, the most common of which is a \c[3]30% weaken\c[0]
Additionally, you will \c[1]move 40% slower\c[0] during the fight but \c[2] dash 50% further \c[0]
Nastier \c[1]debuffs\c[0] include \c[3]overload stacking, food CD extension, and SP draining\c[0]
Carnollo innately \c[1] resists 35% of ranged damage \c[0] to encourage risky close-range plays
I will explain some of the more complicated Carnollo moves
Feel free to skip my dialogue to avoid spoilers
\c[3] Fatal Howl \c[0] is a black sigil resembling the number 8 appearing in Phase 5
Carnollo will instantly grab enemies a short distance away from him and execute a deadly stunlock combo if landed
You will be safe from the grab if you are super close to him, decently far, or dashing
Be wary that this attack usually follows a Realout or Fakeout, so you may have to dash accordingly
\c[1] Nightmare Reign \c[0] is Carnollo's signature move; a red sigil resembling a skull appearing in Phase 5
Carnollo will channel a circle of medium size around him, and check for any enemies within it at the end of the spell
If any enemies are within range, Carnollo \c[3]teleports \c[0] to his summon and lunges quickly at his target's predicted location
Being grabbed by this attack will deal \c[1]enormous\c[0] damage and \c[1]apply every possible debuff\c[0] at once.
This concludes the explanation of Carnollo's most complicated moves
This is extra text to cover the logs of anyone who wanted to skip my dialogue
Best of luck to you, Seeker!
I will explain the \c[3]Cashout/Escape\c[0] mechanic
Each time you \c[2]phase the boss\c[0], a number of materials for the Draconic Circuit will drop.
In base CrossCode, dying deletes any materials gained during a combat rank.
As the creator, I want to encourage learning from death
Therefore, even if you die, your \c[2] mats are safe\c[0].
You simply have to \c[3]use the escape teleporter at the start of combat\c[0] to cash out on your mats
All accumulated mats will be paid out on leaving
The teleporter disappears during the fight, so just take a death to respawn it and leave if you have to.
